children: Skyworks extended the expiration date of its exchange offers for Qorvo’s 4.375% 2029 and 3.375% 2031 notes to Sept. 11, 2026.
Expiration date for the Exchange Offers moved from Sept 1 to Sept 11, 2026, unless further extended or terminated.
Up to $850M of new 4.375% Skyworks 2029 notes and up to $700M of new 3.375% Skyworks 2031 notes are being offered.
As of Sept 1, 2026, $767.518M (90.30%) of 2029 Qorvo notes and $653.022M (93.29%) of 2031 Qorvo notes were validly tendered.
Settlement will occur promptly after the Expiration Date, expected no earlier than the second business day after the Mergers close.
Exchange Offers remain conditioned on closing of the Mergers and all other prospectus terms remain in effect.
